title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03713）：What Should World Models Forget? 把 continual learning 的'retention convention'推到'world models have non-stationary ground truth, so forgetting is required behavior'——挑战 'degradation on previously seen data = failure' 的常规，是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × inference-serving 的'stratified retention for non-stationary world models'趋势资产。'world-model forgetting as feature'范式可迁移到任意 'continual-learning non-stationary environment' 子方向（drift detection / adaptive memory / 在线学习），与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × inference-serving 主线在'world-model memory governance'层面同源。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 stratified retention 形式化、forget/schedule 协议、跨 world-model 验证、与 stationary continual learning baseline 对照。
